doc: Proposed additions to docs/quest-policies/rules.json (owned by L9). Only the 16 existing kinds are used; params extensions (faction_membership, include) are noted per rule and need an L9/L4 decision.

rules.why: Elder McNamara induction scene in Hidden Valley is story-critical; exactly which of the four Hidden Valley cells holds it is unknown, so all four are listed.
AddReputation RepNVBrotherhood at stages 100/101; if the owner wants BoS standing to include faction membership it is shared too. Param extension, not a new kind.
Boone companion quest; hand-in of the beret and wife rescue depend on the companion.
Arcade companion quest ("With Arcade, convince the Remnants...").
Report-back to Hardin completes BoS membership.
Stage 100 admits the Courier to the Brotherhood (vendor stock + standing): shared, party = one Courier.
